spec.purpose: Fixed label-free retrospective taxi interval-flow features

scientific_source.qualification: Original released-NM proxy features; not a true measured taxi queue. No paper code or data reused.

spec.raw_phase_filter: PHASE_mvt == DEP before selecting any feature columns
spec.id_use: Exact alignment, uniqueness, and self-exclusion only; never a predictor
spec.normalization: Airport and runway strip/uppercase using runway_arrival_features.normalized; missing/placeholders invalid
spec.quality_valid_interval: finite AOBT_3_flt and MVT timestamps, 0 <= MVT-AOBT <= 7200 seconds
spec.query: Own quality-valid interval [s=AOBT_3_flt,t=MVT]; otherwise every count is NaN

counts.takeoffs_between: other MVT strictly s < MVT < t; other AOBT may be missing
counts.proxy_starts_between: quality-valid other interval, strictly s < AOBT < t
counts.active_at_takeoff: quality-valid other interval, AOBT <= t < MVT
counts.overtakers: quality-valid other interval, AOBT > s and MVT < t
counts.left_behind: quality-valid other interval, AOBT < s and MVT > t

spec.boundaries: All ten counts exclude the own row, including tied times; zero own duration gives zero takeoffs/starts/overtakers but may have active/left-behind
spec.missing_group: Invalid airport gives NaN in both scopes; invalid runway gives NaN in runway scope only
spec.ranking_availability: Complete released DEP batch available retrospectively; not a real-time forecast
spec.validation_policy: No model fit or labels in this builder; May/September labels remain reserved
